# MDL313 · `quoted-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An option's value is wrapped in quotes, which mydumper keeps.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F4, C4 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl313-quoted-outputdir-keeps-quotes`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl313-quoted-outputdir-keeps-quotes.txtar), [`mdl313-quoted-absolute-outputdir-aborts`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl313-quoted-absolute-outputdir-aborts.txtar) |

## Why

The MySQL client library strips quotes in option files; GLib does not. `outputdir="/backup"` names a directory `"/backup"`, quotes included: relative to the working directory, since it no longer starts with `/`. Remove the quotes. SQL-valued options (`where`) are not checked: their quotes are SQL.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
outputdir="/backup"
database='app'
where="a > 1"
[client]
password="secret"
```

```text
2:11-2:20 warning MDL313[quoted-value] the quotes are part of the value of `outputdir`: GLib does not strip them
  = outputdir gets "/backup", quotes included, not /backup.
  fix (unsafe): Remove the quotes
3:10-3:15 warning MDL313[quoted-value] the quotes are part of the value of `database`: GLib does not strip them
  = database gets 'app', quotes included, not app.
  fix (unsafe): Remove the quotes
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
outputdir=/backup
database=app
where="a > 1"
[client]
password="secret"
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL313: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL313` on the line above it.
